trust_decision.summary: At compile time the version-resource transformer decides whether the generated `changes` map attribute is marked sensitive?; at the pinned commit it derives this from IGNORED attributes (which never enter `changes`) instead of the tracked ones, so a sensitive tracked attribute stored in `changes` (default :display mode) sits in a public, non-sensitive attribute.

landing_point.why: The summary says the changes map is 'non-sensitive'; the only place the `changes` attribute's sensitive? flag is computed is sensitive_changes? in the version-resource transformer.

fix_sites.entry_point: Compile-time DSL: any Ash resource using `extensions: [AshPaperTrail.Resource]` (transformer CreateVersionResource generates <Resource>.Version with `attribute :changes, :map, public?: true, sensitive?: ...`); the leak is then observed via any read of the version resource (Ash.read / paper_trail_versions relationship / inspect / API extensions honouring sensitive?).

O3_reason_to_dismiss: For the attributes_as_attributes route: 'those attributes are copied to their own column which already keeps sensitive?(attr.sensitive?), and the doc says they are stored instead of in the changes map' (lib/resource/resource.ex:63-68, lib/resource/transformers/create_version_resource.ex:294) - yet the runtime change builder still writes them into `changes`.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: `changes` must stay non-sensitive (publicly readable) for resources whose only sensitive attributes are ignored or absent, and the :display/:redact/:ignore modes must keep producing plaintext/"REDACTED"/dropped entries respectively; an over-broad fix (always sensitive?, or redacting values in :display mode) breaks the default-visible audit map and existing tests.

O6_input_shapes: top-level sensitive attribute tracked in `changes` and not listed in ignore_attributes
sensitive attribute listed in ignore_attributes no longer marks `changes` sensitive (inverse of old logic)
sensitive attribute listed in attributes_as_attributes excluded from the check (fix.diff:77)

O7_producer.where: lib/resource/transformers/create_version_resource.ex:309-312 (schema of version resource) vs runtime producer of the map contents lib/resource/changes/create_new_version.ex:141-175

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Sensitive attribute listed in attributes_as_attributes is still written into `changes` (to_skip = pk ++ ignore_attributes only), but the fix explicitly excludes such attributes from the sensitive_changes? check, so in :display mode the secret remains in a non-sensitive `changes`.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Docs say attributes_as_attributes are stored 'instead of' in the changes map and their dedicated column already carries sensitive?; the published fix itself excludes them.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: other file (runtime change module) from the transformer landing point; test/support/posts/post.ex:22,90 + test/ash_paper_trail_test.exs:721-722 show `secret` in both column and changes

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Sensitive fields nested inside embedded/union/list attribute values are dumped verbatim into `changes` (snapshot/changes_only/full_diff) and neither the redaction nor the sensitive_changes? check looks below top-level attribute.sensitive?.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The parent attribute is not itself sensitive?; nested embedded-resource schemas are a 'neighbouring feature'. (Changelog for v0.7.0 lists this as a separate fix not in fix_commits, fix.diff:24.)
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: lib/change_builders/* and lib/change_builders/full_diff/helpers.ex:23-29, different directory from landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: `version_action_inputs` is a public :map attribute never marked sensitive?; only top-level sensitive inputs are replaced with "REDACTED", while nested sensitive fields of embedded inputs pass through dump_to_embedded.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Advisory names the `changes` map only; action inputs are an opt-in audit feature (store_action_inputs?) that already 'redacts sensitive values'.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the changes builder; generated attribute at lib/resource/transformers/create_version_resource.ex:263-268

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Per-changeset sensitive_attributes override (context, line 155-157) vs compile-time mode: a planted variant deriving sensitive? from the resource-level mode would leak when context forces :display.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Maintainer could reasonably optimise 'changes need not be sensitive when mode is :redact/:ignore', forgetting the runtime context override.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: full_diff list/union item dumping path could skip nested redaction separately from snapshot.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: full_diff has its own dumping workaround code, a natural second implementation of value serialisation.

O9_family: CWE-312 cleartext storage / sensitive data exposure (sensitivity flag missing on derived audit field)
